## Overview Validate the dynamic speculative decoding schedule (`num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size`) while building `VllmConfig`, so an invalid schedule fails at startup instead of after the model has loaded. ## Claims - An invalid schedule (overlapping ranges, not starting at 1, negative K, start > end) now raises in `EngineArgs.create_engine_config()`, before the model loads. - An empty schedule warns and falls back to the static `num_speculative_tokens`. Before, it crashed engine startup on Model Runner V2. - Schedules that vLLM already drops (data parallelism, methods Model Runner V1 doesn't support) are still dropped with the existing warning, not rejected. - The schedule rules are documented in the field docstring and on the Dynamic Speculative Decoding page. ## Validation Regression tests through `LLM` (`vllm_runner`, `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`, one A40). CI runs them in "Spec Decode N-Gram + Suffix". ```bash pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/ngram_suffix/test_ngram_suffix.py -k dynamic_sd -v ``` Base (`90c4a1a73e` plus the new tests): both load the model, then the engine core fails with `ValueError: Batch-size ranges must be non-overlapping and sorted.` and `ValueError: num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size must not be empty.` ``` FAILED ...::test_dynamic_sd_invalid_schedule_fails_at_config_time E RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {} FAILED ...::test_dynamic_sd_empty_schedule_falls_back_to_static_k E RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {} ``` This PR: `2 passed`. Config tests (no GPU), `pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dynamic_sd.py`: base `6 failed, 18 passed` (the four invalid schedules do not raise, `[]` is not cleared, the schedule is not normalized); this PR `24 passed`, on macOS and on the A40.
vllm serve before/after (L4, Model Runner V2) ```bash vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --max-model-len 2048 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"ngram","num_speculative_tokens":3,"prompt_lookup_min":2, "prompt_lookup_max":3,"num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size":}' ``` | Schedule | Base | This PR | |---|---|---| | `[[1,16,3],[16,32,2]]` | Loads the model, then `ValueError` in `cudagraph_utils.py` `_init_candidates` | `ValidationError` for `VllmConfig`, no model load | | `[]` | Loads the model, then `ValueError: ... must not be empty` | Warns, falls back to K=3, serves | | `[[1,8,3],[9,64,1]]` | not run | Serves |
`pre-commit` (including mypy) passes. The related config and CUDA graph suites show the same failures on macOS before and after this change (all of them need a GPU). ## Details **Root cause.** The schedule was only validated in `build_dynamic_sd_schedule_lookup`. Its callers that raise run in `EngineCore` after the model loads: the V2 CUDA graph manager (which hits it first) and `Scheduler.__init__`. The early call in `VllmConfig`'s capture-size code caught and ignored the `ValueError`. **Fix.** `VllmConfig._validate_dynamic_sd_schedule()` runs right after `_maybe_disable_dynamic_sd_for_data_parallel()` and `_maybe_disable_dynamic_sd_for_v1()`, so a schedule they drop is never validated and those configs keep starting. A `SpeculativeConfig` field validator would run before those steps and break them. The now-dead `try/except` in the capture-size code is removed, and the `object` parameters in `dynamic/utils.py` are typed. **Not changed.** `build_dynamic_sd_schedule_lookup` still validates its own input. K values above `num_speculative_tokens` are still capped silently (now documented). **Not a duplicate.** No open PR validates the schedule at config time. #48944 and #54801 extend the schedule; this change only calls the module's validator, so it should carry over. #52087 edits the same `VllmConfig` methods, so one of the two will need a small rebase. #54748 and #61123 are complementary. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -32,6 +32,8 @@ implies that:
 * K=1 will be used when the concurrency is in range [65, 128]
 * K=0 will be used when the concurrency is in range [129, 512], i.e., no draft tokens will be produced.
 
+When dynamic SD is enabled, vLLM checks the schedule at startup, before loading the model. The first range must start at 1, ranges must not overlap, and each entry must have `start_bs <= end_bs` and `optimal_K >= 0`. A concurrency that falls in a gap between ranges, or past the last range, uses the preceding range's K. Every K is capped at `num_speculative_tokens`. An empty schedule falls back to the static `num_speculative_tokens`.
+
